title: The Works of Philo Judaeus, Vol. 1
author: Philo of Alexandria (Yonge trans)
description: The first volume of Philo of Alexandria in C. D. Yonge's translation. These writings bring Jewish scripture into conversation with Greek philosophy through allegorical interpretation, ethical reflection and an account of divine wisdom.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/worksphilojudaeu01philuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
